E-Link EL-416GPE – 16-Port Gigabit PoE Switch with 2xGE and 1xSFP Uplink Ports

The E-Link EL-416GPE is a robust 16-port Gigabit PoE+ switch featuring 16 × 10/100/1000 Mbps PoE+ ports, 2 Fast Ethernet (10/100 Mbps) uplink ports, and 1 × 1.25Gbps SFP fiber uplink port. Supporting IEEE 802.3af/at standards, each PoE port delivers up to 30W power, making it perfect for powering IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones.

This switch includes strong surge protection with up to 6kV Ethernet surge immunity and 8kV power surge protection, ensuring reliable operation even in unstable electrical conditions. It offers a high switching capacity of 36 Gbps, handling large data loads for smooth network performance.

The plug-and-play unmanaged design simplifies installation in small to medium business and surveillance environments, with flexible uplink options for extended network reach.


Key Features

  • 16 × Gigabit PoE+ ports (10/100/1000 Mbps) with IEEE 802.3af/at support
  • 2 × Gigabit SFP Port Uplink ports
  • 1 × 1.25 Gbps SFP fiber uplink port for long-distance connection
  • PoE Power: Up to 30W per port
  • Switching Capacity: 36 Gbps for high-speed forwarding
  • Surge Protection: 6kV Ethernet and 8kV power surge protection
  • Auto-negotiation and Auto MDI/MDIX on all ports
  • Plug-and-Play unmanaged design for easy setup
  • Durable metal chassis with efficient cooling
